eval_001.fact_pattern: Tenant in Oakland received a notice of an 8% rent increase from the landlord. The notice included only the dollar amount and effective date, with no mention or enclosure of the Oakland Rent Adjustment Program notice or petition rights.

eval_002.fact_pattern: Landlord in Oakland served a 30-day notice to terminate tenancy stating that the landlord's nephew wishes to move into the apartment. No other grounds were stated in the notice.

eval_003.fact_pattern: Neighbor in a San Francisco residential zone operates an amplified sound system in their backyard at 11:30 PM on a Tuesday, generating noise 12 dBA above the ambient residential level.

eval_004.fact_pattern: Condo owner in San Francisco who lives full-time in New York leases out their San Francisco property on Airbnb for 120 days a year with no primary resident living there.

eval_005.fact_pattern: Landlord of an RSO apartment building in Los Angeles seeks to evict an elderly disabled tenant of 14 years for permanent owner occupancy, but refuses to pay relocation assistance.

eval_006.fact_pattern: Tenant moved out of a rented house in California on June 1. It is now July 10 (40 days later) and the landlord has neither refunded the $2,500 security deposit nor sent an itemized list of deductions.

eval_007.fact_pattern: California landlord retained the tenant's entire $3,000 security deposit out of spite, refusing all phone calls and admitting in a text message that there was no damage to the unit.

eval_008.fact_pattern: Landlord entered tenant's apartment at 9:00 PM on a Sunday without any prior written notice to inspect the kitchen cabinets while tenant was in bed.

eval_009.fact_pattern: Oakland tenant wishes to file a rent increase petition 120 days after receiving a rent hike notice because the landlord never served the mandatory RAP notice.

eval_010.fact_pattern: What constitutes a 'Covered Unit' and a 'RAP Notice' under the Oakland municipal housing regulatory framework?

eval_011.fact_pattern: A residential landlord demands a security deposit equal to 3 months' rent for an unfurnished apartment in California.

eval_012.fact_pattern: Tenant in Oakland was served a termination notice claiming substantial lease violation for hanging pictures on the wall, without any prior written notice to cure.

eval_013.fact_pattern: Commercial air conditioner on an adjacent residential rooftop in San Francisco produces a persistent humming that is 8 dBA over ambient noise at 2:00 AM.

eval_014.fact_pattern: A San Francisco host rents their guest room on VRBO for 45 nights while living in the unit for 300 days a year, but has no certificate from the Office of Short-Term Rentals.

eval_015.fact_pattern: Can an owner in Los Angeles demolish an RSO apartment building without providing relocation compensation to the long-term occupants?

eval_016.fact_pattern: Landlord claims they have the right to enter an apartment at any time without notice to perform routine pest control in California.

eval_017.fact_pattern: Oakland landlord served a 3-day notice to pay or quit based on a 10% rent increase where the RAP notice was omitted from the rent increase service.

eval_018.fact_pattern: Landlord deducted $800 from tenant's security deposit for normal wear and tear painting after a 5-year tenancy in California.

eval_019.fact_pattern: Does the Oakland Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance allow landlords to remove units under the state Ellis Act?

eval_020.fact_pattern: What amount of commercial liability insurance is mandatory for a primary resident operating a transient short-term rental in San Francisco?

eval_021.fact_pattern: Are post-1983 residential buildings in Oakland subject to general rent increase caps or notice requirements?

eval_022.fact_pattern: At what time in the morning does the nighttime residential noise limit under the San Francisco Police Code end?

eval_024.fact_pattern: Does California law still permit 30-day no-fault termination without just cause under Section 1947.10?

eval_025.fact_pattern: Can a California landlord enter an apartment without 24 hours notice if there is a burst pipe flooding the unit?
